title: Learn and study: present tense
summary: Conjugate the exact infinitive in each column. Вчити can mean learning something or teaching someone; вчитися and навчатися make the learner the subject. The fuller forms are shown; standard contracted and у-/в- variants are accepted. Rows use Ukrainian subject pronouns; the він form also serves вона and воно. Ви is plural or polite.

ty.vchytysya.note: In -шся, pronounce a long soft s: [sʲːa]. Keep the spelling шся; a phonetic respelling is not a typed answer.

they.vchytysya.note: In -ться, pronounce a long soft ts affricate: [t͡sʲːa]. Keep ться in spelling.
